item.title: Comma.ai and Tiny Corp Announce Joint eGPU Dock Hardware Product
item.summary: Comma.ai and the tiny corp jointly announced the "tiny chestnut eGPU dock," an ASM2464PD-based external GPU dock with USB4 and PCIe 4.0 x4 connectivity, with a full reveal and pricing expected at 2:00 PM PST on August 12, 2026.
